name: High Volume Churn Bar Failure
note: A churn bar is effort without result: volume at or above the vol_pct percentile of the SAME time-of-day slot over the prior sessions, a range in the bottom rng_pct of the last 100, and a high or low that is the 20-bar extreme. Enormous volume at a swing extreme that goes nowhere means the aggressor was fully absorbed. The trade is not the churn bar -- churn precedes continuation too -- it is the FAILURE: the first close back through the whole churn bar within `win` bars, short if the churn bar set the high, long if it set the low. A later churn bar cancels and replaces the setup. Selects for range CONTRACTION on record volume, the exact opposite of an ATR-expansion filter.
source: The 'High Volume Churn' bar type (high volume, low range) is one of the five classifications in the Better Volume indicator, documented at https://www.motivewave.com/studies/better_volume.htm and in the original description doc at https://c.mql5.com/forextsd/forum/147/better_volume_indicator__description.doc (the indicator originates from emini-watch.com). Those sources define the bar type and describe topping/bottoming sequences qualitatively; the percentile thresholds, the failure trigger and the exits are my specification.
